name: filecon-monorepo
description: Filecon – file type icons for 703 formats, for every framework.

scripts.test: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=2 test && pnpm pack:check && pnpm sizes --check && pnpm test:rust
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path crates/filecon/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path crates/filecon-dioxus/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path crates/tauri-plugin-filecon/Cargo.toml
